schemas.overview: JSON data models for the MoMo SMS Processing System — maps relational DB entities to API-ready structures

user.description: Represents a Mobile Money account holder extracted from SMS metadata

transaction_category.description: Classifies the nature of each MoMo transaction

sample.description: Direct payment sent to another account holder

user_category_preference.description: Junction entity representing user notification preferences for category alerts (M:N resolution)

transaction.description: Full transaction record enriched with nested sender, receiver, and category entities

sample.raw_text: You have received 3000 RWF from Alice Mugabo (+250791666666) on your mobile money account at 2024-05-10 16:30:51. Financial Transaction Id: 76662021700.

joins: LEFT JOIN users sender ON transactions.sender_id = sender.id
LEFT JOIN users receiver ON transactions.receiver_id = receiver.id
JOIN transaction_categories category ON transactions.category_id = category.id

system_log.description: System log entry capturing processing pipeline execution events and diagnostic errors

sample.message: XML payload successfully parsed. Total raw records: 5

rules.direct: SQL table columns map directly 1-to-1 to top-level JSON fields
rules.nested: Related entities (sender, receiver, category) are serialized as nested JSON sub-objects
rules.computed: Aggregated analytics (total volume, transaction counts) are calculated server-side in SQL
rules.nulls: SQL NULL foreign keys (e.g., receiver_id for agent top-ups) render as JSON null
